name: Edwina Breitzke
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Hello and welcome. I am an IFS specialist and Certified Level 3-trained Internal Family Systems (IFS) therapist , working online and based in Melbourne, Australia. I work with adults (18+) experiencing a wide range of concerns including anxiety, depression, trauma, attachment and relationship difficulties, shame, grief, life transitions, estrangement, and recovery from narcissistic abuse.

description: I’m Edwina Van Der Westhuizen , a holistic brief therapist, Family Constellations trainer and facilitator, and Masters-qualified counsellor. If you are looking for assistance with family issues relationship issues grief / loss trauma / abuse parenting issues addictions emotional struggles feeling stuck Edwina works somatically, systemically and with brain spots that keep us stuck. She works with not just talk therapy yet many other modailities Family Constellations Brain spotting Emotional Freedom Technique (EFT) Parts work Inner child work
